Sandbox_PZShareMapNotes_AutoShareSymbols: Controls who sees your map symbols and freehand drawings. Everyone = all players on the server. Faction = only your faction members. Safehouse = only your safehouse members. Disabled = vanilla manual sharing for symbols, drawings are private only.
Sandbox_PZShareMapNotes_MaxStrokesPerPla: Maximum freehand drawings each player can have on the shared map (5-100). Default: 30. Oldest drawings must be erased to make room for new ones.
Sandbox_PZShareMapNotes_MaxStrokesTotal_: Maximum total freehand drawings across all players on the server (50-1000). Default: 200. Prevents excessive storage growth on busy servers.
Sandbox_PZShareMapNotes_RequirePenToDraw: When enabled, players need a pen or pencil in their inventory to use freehand drawing. The drawing color matches the pen type. When disabled, anyone can draw in orange.
Sandbox_PZShareMapNotes_RequireEraserToE: When enabled, players need an eraser in their inventory to use the erase tool. When disabled, anyone can erase.
